paper.title: Discovery of a directly imaged disk in scattered light around the Sco-Cen member Wray 15-788

notes: First-published SPHERE/IRDIS scattered-light image (VLT/SPHERE, RDI+PCA total intensity and polarized light). A bright outer ring (Ring A, ~370 mas / 56 au) with hints of an inner ring (Ring B, ~170 mas) is detected only over a limited position-angle range (60-240 deg), consistent with shadowing by a misaligned inner disk. Wray 15-788 is part of a wide binary with the A2V star HD 98363 (~5000 arcsec / ~6900 au) (Bohn et al. 2019).
